newsitem.title: USA: EZ Comm restructures stations swap.
newsitem.headline: EZ Comm restructures stations swap.

text.p: EZ Communications Inc, parent company of radio stations KMPS-AM/FM and KZOK-FM in Seattle, said Monday it is restructuring its previously announced letter of intent with Evergreen Media Corporation.

Under the terms of the restructured transaction, EZ will exchange its Philadelphia stations WIOQ-FM and WUSL-FM plus $10 million for Evergreen's four FM and two AM stations in Charlotte, N.C.: WPEG-FM; WBAV AM/FM; WNKS-FM; WRFX-FM and WFNZ-AM.
EZ anticipates that WRFX-FM will be acquired by a trust with the intention of either selling or exchanging the station at a later date.

EZ also said it terminated its letter of intent with SFX Broadcasting Inc. EZ said the terminated letter of intent involved two Charlotte stations, with EZ to swap WSSS-FM and WNKS-FM, in exchange for WTDR-FM and cash.
Pending the transactions, EZ will own 24 radio stations located in the markets of Seattle, St. Louis, Pittsburgh, Sacramento, Charlotte, and Kansas City.
